summary: Recognize explicit Outlook-style quoted headers when From and the secondary mail labels share one visible HTML line, preserving the current RFI response role.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where a single-line Outlook quoted header changed an RFI response role to MIXED
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued email and workflow adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: The boundary is intentionally conservative: From must start the visible line and at least one explicit Sent, Date, To or Subject label must also be present.
MSG, mailbox synchronization, malformed MIME recovery and semantic thread inference remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model or external provider request is used.
